name: io.github.StefanKnol/mikrotik-mcp
title: MikroTik RouterOS
description: MikroTik RouterOS over the binary API, addressing rules by real .id not list position.

environmentVariables.name: MIKROTIK_HOST
environmentVariables.description: IP address or hostname of the router, e.g. 192.168.88.1

environmentVariables.name: MIKROTIK_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: RouterOS user. Use a dedicated account rather than admin; its group must carry the `api` policy, and a group without it is rejected with the same error as a wrong password.

environmentVariables.name: MIKROTIK_PORT
environmentVariables.description: API port: 8729 for api-ssl (default), 8728 for plaintext.

environmentVariables.name: MIKROTIK_TLS
environmentVariables.description: Use the TLS API. Defaults to true; turning it off sends the router password over the network in the clear.

environmentVariables.name: MIKROTIK_TLS_FINGERPRINT
environmentVariables.description: SHA-256 of the router certificate. MikroTik's API-SSL certificate is self-signed, so pinning this is what makes the connection authenticated rather than merely encrypted.

environmentVariables.name: MIKROTIK_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Connection timeout in seconds. Defaults to 10.
